svg.text: The Big Picture — UI: the notice board · the board is in the repo
🧱 PART 1 — THE BOARD (lessons 1–6)
📌 what people see IS the product
the record room keeps the truth, the counter
answers slips — the board is where a person
finally sees any of it (HTML → DOM → paint)
🧱🎨 structure + looks
header · nav · main · form with labels · alt text —
meaning every tool understands · box model, flexbox,
grid · mobile first, one column → two at 720px
⚡🧠 alive — events and state
event → change state → render() · one source of
truth · components are functions of data ·
fetch with a timeout; textContent, never innerHTML
♿ everyone can read the board
Tab reaches everything, focus is visible, a skip link ·
every input has a label, every image an alt ·
contrast 4.5:1 · aria-live announces what changed
🔬 ui/index.html + ui/styles.css + ui/app.js — three files, no framework, no build
80 lines of semantic HTML · 60 lines of tokens and layout · 100 lines of state → render, events and fetch
python3 ui/mock_api.py serves the board and its counter; ?slow=1 and ?fail=1 show the loading and error faces
⚠️ the two mistakes every first board makes
a <div onclick> instead of a <button> (no keyboard, no focus, no announcement) —
and state kept in the DOM, edited in three places, drifting apart. UI = render(state).
python3 ui/mock_api.py · python3 ui/smoke_test.py — the board, and ten checks that it still stands
🚚 PART 2 — SHIPPING THE BOARD (lessons 7–12)
🧰🎽 frameworks · the uniform (7–8)
React, Vue, Svelte automate state → view,
diffing, components — the ideas you did by
hand; vanilla until three components share state
tokens: --bg --ink --accent --space-2 · dark
mode is a token swap, components never change
🚀🧪 fast · tested (9–10)
fewer bytes, right-sized lazy images, long
max-age + hashed names, a CDN · LCP, INP,
CLS measured on a slow phone
the pyramid: many unit, some component, few
end-to-end · smoke checks in CI on every push
📨 talking to the counter (11)
CORS says who may call from a browser ·
no API keys in JS — short-lived user tokens ·
three faces per request: loading, success, error ·
validate on the board for kindness,
on the counter for truth
🚚 pinned up (12)
the board is just files: static hosting,
a CDN, cache-busted by build hash ·
GitHub Pages / S3 + CloudFront ·
watch real users: JS errors, web vitals
(this School's own pages ship this way)
🧭 read one board, read them all: HTML means something · CSS bends to the screen · events change state, state renders the view
semantics make it accessible · tokens make it consistent · fewer bytes make it fast · a few tests keep it standing · the counter is never trusted by, nor trusts, the board
siblings: the API school is the counter this board fills slips for · the Database school is the record room behind it · the CI/CD school pins the board up on every push
